biotools.summary: BioSpring is an interactive molecular modeling and simulation framework that utilizes an augmented elastic network model to provide intuitive insights into biomolecular dynamics. It enables real-time exploration of macromolecular mechanics and supports a variety of applications including protein docking and structural analysis.
